draft_en.subject: A second-source DIN-rail PoE switch for your industrial customers
draft_en.body:
Hi,

I wrote on 4 October about our 24-port PoE L2+ switch ('24 Port PoE Managed Switch'); this is a different angle, so a fresh note rather than a reply.

STI-288DGGPM: DIN-rail industrial L2+ switch, 8 x GE PoE+ (240 W budget) + 2 x SFP (1G/2.5G), -40 to +75 C, dual DC input, ERPS ring, SNMPv3, USD 137 EXW Shenzhen (snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days), CE/RoHS, 3-year warranty. Same family: STI-244DGGPM (4 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, 120 W) at USD 121 and STI-488DGGPM (8 x PoE+ + 4 x SFP, 240 W) at USD 147.

Would a second-source DIN-rail PoE switch be worth a test unit next to the industrial brands you carry?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
